R1.text: Returns are accepted within {return_window_days} days of delivery.

exchange.description: Offer an exchange (store credit at full price) instead of a refund.

R10.text: Agents may offer an exchange instead of a refund on eligible apparel returns.

R3.text: Opened electronics returned for a change of mind carry a {restocking_fee_pct}% restocking fee.

R4.text: Gold members pay {gold_fee_discount_pct}% less restocking fee.

R5.text: Defective items get a prepaid return label. Other returns pay ${return_shipping_fee} return shipping, deducted from the refund.

ledger.description: Record the refund in the ledger.

R6.text: An eligible return is refunded the price less any restocking fee and return shipping, and the refund is posted to the returns ledger.

R7.text: An ineligible return is denied, with the reason.

R8.text: Every eligible return gets a return label.

R9.text: Gold members receive a loyalty credit of {loyalty_credit_pct}% of the price on eligible returns.

attribution: Behavioral Update Fidelity was introduced by Michele Joseph in 2026.
